Milk Thistle

Remedy liver-support detoxification antioxidant

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Herb renowned for liver protection and detoxification support. Contains silymarin, which protects liver cells.

Indications

  • liver support
  • detoxification
  • fatty liver
  • hepatitis

Contraindications

  • allergy to ragweed/daisy family

Preparations

  • standardized extract
  • capsule
  • tea

Body Systems Affected

  • liver
  • digestive
